items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: And a great violinist, too, was playing with Fletcher then, Edgar Sampson.

ctx.x: He was playing with Fletcher. He was playing with Fletcher then. And a great violinist, too, was playing with Fletcher then, Edgar Sampson. He was in Fletcher's band when I first came to New York.
Edgar Sampson was a great violinist?
